This package includes a modified EasyTier 2.6.4 build, 2.6.4-civ6.2.
Modifications for Civ6 Relay, 2026-10-30: fast relay failover between
credential clients, recovery hysteresis, cached authenticated coordinator
selection, and data-path route status. The wire format is unchanged.
License: GNU LGPL version 3.
Source commit: 8428a89d2dabc94c97d370ec607c6ca142473626
Upstream: https://github.com/EasyTier/EasyTier
Release: https://github.com/EasyTier/EasyTier/releases/tag/v2.6.4
The EasyTier source snapshot and build manifests are included in
EasyTier-2.6.4-source.tar.gz. The public source archive omits only the six
Packet.dll/Packet.lib artifacts; retained source files are unchanged.
Original and published archive hashes and omitted artifact hashes are in
BUILD-MANIFEST.json. Dependency revisions are in its Cargo.lock.
Apply EasyTier-fast-failover.patch to that source; build instructions are
in BUILD-CIV6.txt. The same patched source is used for Linux and Windows.
The desktop launcher invokes EasyTier as a separate process.

The unchanged Windows components redistributed here are Wintun 0.14.1
and WinDivert. Their licenses are provided alongside this notice. Wintun
uses the separate official Prebuilt Binaries License in Wintun-LICENSE.txt.
Wintun: https://www.wintun.net/
WinDivert: https://reqrypt.org/windivert.html

Windows cross-build source and build-only dependency path changes are
documented in BUILD-CIV6.txt; the modified dependency source is included as
windivert-rust-adcc56d-civ6-source.tar.gz. Optional Win7 thunks are not used.

Civ6.2 also adds an optional dhcp_subnet setting and randomizes the first
automatic address candidate to avoid simultaneous join collisions.

Public packaging variant 3.2.5-no-npcap (2026-10-31) removes the Windows
pnet interface-enumeration fallback. The existing network-interface/IP
Helper enumeration is preserved; a failure is logged and yields an empty
list. The selected Cargo features exclude faketcp. Rebuilt Windows
executables have no Packet.dll import and require no Npcap installation.
The native version remains 2.6.4-civ6.2; protocol and normal network
behavior are unchanged. Exact source and patch hashes are in
BUILD-MANIFEST.json.

The Windows linker uses only the legacy WinPcap 4.1.2 SDK x64 import
library as a private build input; it is not redistributed in this package.
Its official BSD-style license is preserved in WinPcap-SDK-LICENSE.txt,
and its source URL and hashes are in BUILD-MANIFEST.json. This does not
license or redistribute any Npcap DLL.
